report.summary: 4 high-severity items: fix Intent.trace_id default, audit graph_brief budget, check render's quarantine handling, verify shared walk pipeline; 1 medium: surface token-exact flag.
risks: Fixing trace_id default may break callers that rely on current behavior
graph_brief budget fix may change truncation behavior
render.py quarantine fix may alter map output
token-exact flag surfacing may require UI changes
todos: Inspect render.py analyse_once usage of by_provenance

items.title: Add default value for trace_id in Intent dataclass
items.why_now: Fixes a TypeError that blocks all callers omitting trace_id; high severity confirmed.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/council/session.py around the Intent dataclass definition to confirm missing default.
steps.verified_by: Run 'python -c "from daedalus.council.session import Intent; i = Intent()"' and confirm no TypeError.

steps.do: Add default value (e.g., field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))) for trace_id.
steps.verified_by: Run the same command and confirm it succeeds.

steps.do: Update docstring to reflect the default behavior.
steps.verified_by: grep for 'trace_id' in session.py and verify docstring matches.

items.assumption: The dataclass is indeed in daedalus/council/session.py; if not, adjust path based on grep results.

items.title: Audit graph_brief._emit budget check for header cost inclusion
items.why_now: Potential token budget overshoot causes truncation that ollama cannot repair; high severity narrowed claim.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/kairos/graph_brief.py lines 283-294 to see if header cost is subtracted from budget before adding lines.
steps.verified_by: Read the code; if header cost is not included, proceed to fix.

steps.do: If header cost is missing, add it to the budget check before deciding to add a line.
steps.verified_by: Run existing tests for graph_brief (test_graph_brief.py) and verify no regressions.

items.assumption: The _emit function is within lines 283-294; if not, adjust based on actual location.

items.title: Ensure render.py analyse_once includes quarantine tasks in reports
items.why_now: Quarantine tasks counted but missing from reach/switch reports if analyse_once uses by_provenance; high severity confirmed.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/mapping/render.py for analyse_once function and how it uses evaluation aggregates.
If analyse_once uses by_provenance results, modify to include quarantine tasks or adjust the pipeline.
steps.verified_by: Run test_mapping_reach.py and test_mapping_switches.py to verify reports include quarantine tasks.

items.assumption: analyse_once is defined in render.py; if not, adjust based on grep results.

items.title: Verify shared data pipeline in render.py analyse_once
items.why_now: Unverifiable shared walk may cause data inconsistency; high severity narrowed claim.

steps.do: grep -n 'analyse_once' daedalus/mapping/render.py and grep -rn 'analyse_once' daedalus/ to locate all references.
steps.verified_by: List of files and lines containing analyse_once.

steps.do: Inspect the implementation to confirm that reach and switch reports are generated from a shared data pipeline.
steps.verified_by: Code review: if pipeline is not shared, refactor to share data or document the design.

items.assumption: analyse_once exists and is the function described; adjust based on grep results.

items.title: Surface token-exact flag in all callers of _whole_repo_tokens and semantic_slice
items.why_now: If callers ignore the exact flag, reduction ratio may be misleading; medium severity.

steps.do: Find all callers of _whole_repo_tokens and semantic_slice in the codebase.
For each caller, ensure the exact flag is surfaced to the user or used to adjust confidence.
steps.verified_by: Code review of each caller; update docstrings or logs to indicate fallback.

items.assumption: Callers are identifiable; if none exist, the issue is moot.
